notes: «أمرني عبد الرحمن بن أبزى أن أسأل ابن عباس» has Ibn Abza only giving the order (in the scene, not a link, rule 6); Ibn Abbas is the one asked who answers («فسألته فقال»), so he is the last link.
«وعن هذه الآية» has no isnad of its own and is read as the same route, so there is no second route.
